findings.evidence: Glob of code/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/* lists both `Hom.lean` and `HomProd.lean`. The docstring of `Hom.lean` covers smooth hom-bundle sections, including `ContMDiff.clm_bundle_comp`, which is the sibling of the new `clm_bundle_prod`.
findings.fix: `git mv` `Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/Hom.lean` to `Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/Hom/Basic.lean`, put this file at `Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/Hom/Prod.lean`, and update every importer, including `CauchyRiemann/Constructions.lean` and `FiniteBundleAtlas/Hom.lean`, in this PR. Do not rename any declarations.
findings.issue: The new file puts `HomProd.lean` next to the existing `Hom.lean` in `Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/`. The shared prefix `Hom` names their common subject (Hom-bundle sections), so the two files should not stay flat.

findings.evidence: The `InCoordinates` section variables contain only `[TopologicalSpace B] [TopologicalSpace B']` and bundle instances. `TauCeti/Topology/VectorBundle/Hom.lean` already holds the topological `inCoordinates` API (51 hits, e.g. `ContinuousWithinAt.inCoordinates_clm_comp` at line 101 and `ContinuousLinearMap.inCoordinates_apply_continuousLinearMapAt₂` at line 660).
findings.fix: Move both lemmas to `TauCeti/Topology/VectorBundle/Hom.lean`, next to the existing coordinate lemmas for Hom bundles. Have the manifold file import them from there.
findings.issue: `ContinuousLinearMap.inCoordinates_prod_eq` and `ContinuousLinearMap.inCoordinates_prod` use only `TopologicalSpace B`, `FiberBundle` and `VectorBundle`, with no charted or manifold structure, yet they are placed in a `Geometry/Manifold` file.

summary: The new `HomProd.lean` is left flat next to `Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/Hom.lean` instead of both moving into a `Hom/` directory, and its purely topological `inCoordinates` lemmas are in a manifold-level file instead of `Topology/VectorBundle/Hom.lean`.
